title: Hosting and deployment
goal: Prepare a build and a reversible release.
explanation: A static site can be served as files; an application with a backend needs a compatible server/runtime. Understand which parts execute in the browser and which execute on the server.
Use separate development and production configuration. Keep server secrets out of client-exposed variables and built assets. Run relevant checks before release.
Configure HTTPS, health checks, logging without secrets and a rollback plan. Verify the deployed behaviour and links. A successful upload alone does not prove the application works.
code:
Release checklist
- Review changes and configuration
- Run tests and production build
- Deploy to a preview environment
- Verify core flows
- Release with a rollback available
- Monitor failures
exercise: Write a deployment checklist for a static portfolio and identify what would change for a Node backend.
hint: Match the hosting environment to the runtime your project needs.

quiz.question: Where should a private database password live?
quiz.explanation: Anything shipped to the browser can be inspected. Private credentials belong on the server.
